name: Setup incomplete
description: A single nudge for an account that signed up and stopped halfway, naming the one step that is actually blocking them.

origin.note: Design: personal letter — no canvas, no logo, no social chrome, serif body, one underlined link instead of a button.

subject: One step left: {{ blocking_step }}
preheader: It's the only thing standing between your account and a first send.

blocking_step.description: The single step that is blocking them. One, not a list — a nudge that names three things gets ignored.

time_estimate.description: Honest time estimate, set beside the step. Overstating it is better than understating it.

why_it_matters.description: What that step unlocks. Motivation beats instruction.
why_it_matters.default: Until it's done, anything you send goes out from our shared domain, which hurts delivery and looks generic to the people receiving it.

action_url.description: Direct link to the blocking step, not to a generic dashboard.

button_label.description: Call to action, rendered as a plain underlined link in keeping with the letter format.

sender_name.description: Who the note is from. A real name outperforms a team name here, which is the entire point of this design.

opt_out_text.description: Way out of the nudge sequence. Offering it is what keeps it a nudge.
opt_out_text.default: Not ready yet? We'll stop reminding you after this one.
